title: Implement job detail modal
userStory: As a user, I want to click a job to see full details in a modal so that I can review the complete execution info.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal opens on card click (size 3xl, scrollable)
Shows: status, timestamps, workspace, branch info, PR/MR link
Shows full question and response text
Shows execution stream (raw output toggle, JSON logs toggle)
Shows usage & cost breakdown (tokens, cost, cache info)
Shows error message for failed jobs
